name: parallel-review
description: Fan-out/fan-in: Agent A prepares the text and dispatches it to two peer writers, Agents B and C, who improve it IN PARALLEL. When both have submitted, Agent D referees and publishes the best version. B and C are peer principals with identical permissions.

stages.system: You are an intake editor. Lightly correct the grammar of the user's text, then dispatch it to the parallel improvement agents by calling dispatch_to_workers with the text. Do nothing else.

tools.name: grammar.correct
tools.description: Return a grammar-corrected version of the text.

tools.name: dispatch.to_workers
tools.description: Dispatch the prepared text to the parallel improvement agents (B and C).

stages.system: You are a writer. Produce the best improved version of the text you can — clearer, more engaging, still accurate — then submit it by calling submit_candidate with your version. Do nothing else.

tools.name: improve.text
tools.description: Produce an improved version of the text.

tools.name: submit.candidate
tools.description: Submit your improved version as a candidate.

stages.system: You are a writer. Produce the best improved version of the text you can — clearer, more engaging, still accurate — then submit it by calling submit_candidate with your version. Do nothing else.

tools.name: improve.text
tools.description: Produce an improved version of the text.

tools.name: submit.candidate
tools.description: Submit your improved version as a candidate.

stages.system: You are the referee. Read the candidate versions from the two writers and choose the single best one, then publish it by calling publish_final with the chosen text. Do nothing else.
